channel.title: The Titans of All'Terra — Season 2, Part 1 (Episodes 1-13)
channel.description: Custom fan-made feed: story episodes only, in season order, trimmed for Yoto's 25-track limit. Season 2, Part 1 (Episodes 1-13). Original show: The Titans of All'Terra by Joshua Lorimer.
channel.itunes:author: Joshua Lorimer

item.title: S2E1 A New Kingdom
item.itunes:title: A New Kingdom
item.description: It's been six months since the events of Season 1. The empty Dwarven kingdom has now become the staging ground for a united resistance. Some semblance of peace has been found here, thanks in no small part to our four heroes and their powerful golems.

item.itunes:title: A Thing Beyond
item.description: Dalfin heads to the monastery at the request of the masters and Relnor takes a walk along the city walls while Joan and Winnie delve deeper into the ancient ruins.

item.itunes:title: A Change of Plans
item.description: Winnie discovers a way to communicate with the Well, possibly breaking her promise. And the heroes are faced with a choice that could decide the future of the Four Kingdoms.

item.description: Our heroes go about their daily lives within the newly formed kingdom, encountering new characters and learning more about All'Terra.

item.title: S2E5 A Southern Fang
item.itunes:title: A Southern Fang
item.description: Joan questions an old elf while Relnor shares a drink with an Urdan friend from the South. Neither are truly what they seem.

item.title: S2E6 A Prone Encounter
item.itunes:title: A Prone Encounter
item.description:
Titanic wolves brimming with elemental powers are rampaging through the kingdom. Relnor, stabbed in the back by Bjorn through a knife in the chest, does his best to keep things together while Winnie, Dalfin, and Joan defend themselves against the wolf titans.

item.itunes:title: A Given One
item.description: This week Relnor, Dalfin, and Winnie catch and confront the urdan traitor, but what he reveals is something no one expected. Meanwhile, Joan struggles to wake her golem up.

item.title: S2E13 A Kingdom Conquered
item.itunes:title: A Kingdom Conquered
item.description: Having met Jimmy and spoken with Valla'Sol, our heroes make way for the Kingdom of Allestria. Once called The People's Kingdom, the party learns quickly that such a title no longer suits it. Allestria is now the Kingdom of the White Order and the Dwarves.
